props.name: children
props.description: The panel itself: real text, real buttons. It is what hangs.

props.name: pins
props.description: Where the cloth is held: the whole top edge, its two top corners, the left edge (a flag), or nowhere.

props.name: cols
props.description: Points across. Kept under the clone budget of 140 triangles together with `rows`.

props.name: rows
props.description: Points down.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Downward pull, in px per step².

props.name: damping
props.description: Velocity kept each step. Lower is more damped.

props.name: iterations
props.description: Constraint passes per step. More is stiffer and less stretchy.

props.name: wind
props.description: Wind strength, 0 (still) to 1 (a gale).

props.name: windDirection
props.description: Direction the wind blows towards, in degrees: 0 is right, 90 is down.

props.name: gusts
props.description: Blow in gusts with calm spells between them, rather than steadily.

props.name: tearable
props.description: Let links break when stretched past `tearLimit`.

props.name: tearLimit
props.description: Stretch ratio at which a link breaks.

props.name: onTear
props.description: Called with the running count of broken links whenever the cloth tears.

props.name: onMotionChange
props.description: Called with true when the clones take over, and false when the real content is back.

props.name: calmOnHover
props.description: Drop the wind while a pointer is over the panel, so it settles and can be used.

props.name: shading
props.description: How strongly folds are shaded, 0 to 1.

props.name: bleed
props.description: Extra room, in px, drawn around each edge so a shadow or border travels with the cloth.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the simulation where it is.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the panel in the handle’s accessible label, as in “Shake the offer”.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last onto the outer element, so it wins.
